incoming.name: Parsnip

incoming.name: Rice
incoming.excerpt: The shallow puddles take advantage of the rice plant's tolerance to water; the water in the paddies prevents weeds from outgrowing the crop.

outgoing.name: Greenhouse effect
outgoing.excerpt: In the case of using the black plastic sheet, the greenhouse effect is used to kill the plants beneath the sheet.
